why: Removed no-fly zones let UAS enter restricted airspace; unsecured API, serious safety and regulatory consequences.
Poisoned SSOT cascades to all services simultaneously; single point of failure, no integrity verification.
Third-party feed spoofing is easy and unverified; unsafe routing but pilots and operators provide partial mitigation.
Log tampering hides incidents and breaches retention duties; no direct operational or safety effect.
API key theft and credential stuffing are common; bulk flight-plan exfiltration causes privacy and regulatory harm.
SQL injection on unpatched server is widespread; mass exfiltration and corruption degrade all data-dependent services.
Tampered authority audit logs let violations go unpunished; indirect effect, loss of trust and enforcement.
Loopholes allow USSPs without cybersecurity management; slow systemic weakness rather than immediate operational impact.
Leak of strategic plans and risk register aids adversaries; insider and access-control weaknesses make it plausible.
GNSS spoofing and jamming are frequent and cheap; UAS deviation into restricted airspace risks fatalities.
C2 jamming during BVLOS is easy and well documented; loss of control risks collision and fatalities.
Unsigned firmware and exposed debug ports allow persistent compromise; requires physical or update-channel access.
Power loss or BMS manipulation shuts down ground station or causes uncontrolled landing; redundancy lacking.
Sensor spoofing without cross-validation causes wrong flight decisions and crashes; practical attacks demonstrated in literature.
Physical sabotage of vertiport controls creates UAM safety risk; requires on-site access, localized effect.
Backdoored firmware via trusted vendor affects entire fleet; severe but supply chain attacks are rarer.
Fake identities and stolen credentials enable unaccountable operations; weak proofing makes attack easy.
False telemetry creates phantom aircraft and hides real conflicts; no validation or anomaly detection.
JWT none-algorithm bypass grants unauthorised flight approvals into restricted airspace; known, easily exploited flaw.
Unprotected gateway flood causes complete USSP outage, all flight authorisations unavailable; DDoS common.
Fake geofence injection lets UAS enter restricted zones; unverified feeds, serious safety and regulatory effects.
